pilot.mapping_policy: pilot_lesson_map links introductory or repeated topic subsets only. A pilot session does not complete the linked full lessons, satisfy all their prerequisites, or award their outcomes automatically. Pilot sessions have their own prerequisite chain; P09 and P10 do not require completion of M04 or M05. Any required concept must be introduced inside the pilot before assessment.

status_policy.module_pages: Module Pages contain curriculum design and introductions, not complete lesson packages.
status_policy.pilot_mapping: A ready pilot session does not mark its linked full curriculum lessons or outcomes complete.
status_policy.publication: Page delivery is verified only when every required URL is present and readback_verified is true.
status_policy.mastery: Technical execution does not assess learner mastery or professional grade.
